label: Effective width of a FinFET
subgoals: Add twice the fin height to the fin width
Multiply by the number of fins
Relate fin thinness to full depletion and electrostatic control

label: Drive current from effective width
subgoals: Convert the effective width to microns
Multiply by the quoted current per unit width
Account for parasitics that the intrinsic estimate omits

label: Width quantization
subgoals: Divide the required current by the current per fin
Round up to a whole number of fins
Relate fin quantization to cell drive strengths and ratios
